title: Import a Firecrawl result
description: Imports the result of a completed crawl or batch scrape into a knowledge collection, one document per page; new pages are created, changed pages replaced, unchanged pages skipped.

collection.title: Knowledge collection
collection.description: IRI of the target knowledge collection; its UUID or its name is accepted as well. The collection must not hold crawler-ingested chunks.

deleteVanished.title: Remove vanished pages
deleteVanished.description: Crawls only: remove the documents of the same site imported from Firecrawl earlier whose page is no longer in this crawl. Runs only after a complete import without failed pages; uploaded documents and documents of other sites are never removed.
